name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly — nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Bundles its own Python runtime. Needs GRP_MCP_CONNECTIONS pointing at your connections.json.
